name: Slackおまかせくん
tagline: React with an emoji on any Slack message and pick a ready-made task, reply or event.
description: A small-chore assistant for Slack, made for the work that sits outside development. Add a robot emoji to any message and it prepares three moves from the message's context: a task entry, a draft reply, a calendar slot. You pick one and it carries through, so handing off the errand takes a couple of clicks.
author: osarupolice
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
